name: custom-cursor
title: Custom cursor
description: A soft blob trails the pointer inside a region; native cursor returns on leave.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DzCursor, useReducedMotion } from '../motion'

const reduced = useReducedMotion()
</script>

<template>
  <!-- The blob eases toward the pointer each frame (transform only, rAF) and is
       non-interactive, so it never traps the pointer — links inside stay
       clickable. Touch/keyboard keep the native cursor; off under reduced motion. -->
  <DzCursor :disabled="reduced" :size="36">
    <!-- …any surface / content… -->
  </DzCursor>
</template>

export { default as DzCursor } from './components/DzCursor.vue'
export { useReducedMotion } from './useReducedMotion.ts'
